description.value: You and the Hollow gain concealment specifically against electronic, mechanical-sensory, or ghost-machine-sighted detection for the duration.

cinderfall.incomplete: Needs an Immunity type narrower than the real "detection" type (pf2e-source/src/scripts/config/iwr.ts), which blocks ALL detection (divination, scrying, ordinary Perception-based location magic) rather than only "electronic/mechanical-sensory" detection as this card claims -- using it would over-grant immunity to mundane Perception and ordinary magical scrying the card never claims to block. No narrower real type or predicate for machine-sense-specific detection exists. Convert-never-flatten: not substituted.
cinderfall.listing: Covenant Vessel Spells / Ghost-Static machine spirits · lowest risk
